judge.rationale: The candidate stopped midway through implementation, leaving the test suite broken because `src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts` asserts runtime input validation that was never wired into `ToolRegistry.execute`. While `ajv` was added to `package.json` and `ToolRegistry.register` compiles schemas at registration time, `execute` never calls `validateInput` and does not resolve or cache function-valued `ToolDefinitionSource` schemas per call. Most required unit tests in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts` and `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` are missing, as is the required one-line doc comment on `execute`. None of the required documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`) were performed, and an extraneous `.lore/dod.md` file was left in the diff.
